description: This EOB holds six visits built to look wrong but correct: an out-of-network surgeon's consented difference, a ground ambulance's difference, a problem visit beside a $0 screening, an out-of-network specialist's difference, an out-of-network lab's differences left out of the out-of-pocket total, and an elective surgery denied for no prior authorization, its note pointing to the appeal rights. It has no billing error; its two correct denials are to be surfaced, and nothing else should be flagged.

sources.what: Content of a notice of adverse benefit determination (every EOB that pays less than billed)
